probes.title: Shape-Only Edge Sketch
probes.description: Strips color and surface texture, leaving only high-pass structural contours.

probes.title: Monochrome (No Color)
probes.description: Removes all color channels to test if hue/albedo tint drives the prediction.

probes.title: Warm Color Cast Shift
probes.description: Shifts color temperature from cool/neutral toward warm amber/desert tones.

probes.title: Low-Pass Blur (Coarse Shape)
probes.description: Removes high-frequency fur and snow-grain texture while preserving coarse silhouette.

probes.title: 2×2 Global Patch Shuffle
probes.description: Permutes 4 quadrants to disrupt global object geometry while keeping local parts intact.

probes.title: 4×4 Texture Patch Scramble
probes.description: Scrambles 16 patches to destroy global shape while preserving local texture statistics.

probes.title: High-Frequency Noise (σ=26)
probes.description: Injects zero-mean Gaussian pixel noise to test robustness against high-frequency corruptions.

probes.title: Tight Subject Crop (Zoom)
probes.description: Crops tightly around the segmented foreground subject to minimize peripheral background.

summary: Under a 4×4 patch scramble (destroying global shape), the model retains 17.7% confidence for 'timber wolf', compared to 0.2% on the high-pass edge sketch and 66.6% on low-pass coarse shape. Stripping color (Grayscale) yields 57.3%, while a warm desert color cast shifts confidence to 83.2% (timber wolf).
